title: Edge deployment mutation acknowledgement v1
description: Conditional proxy DELETE or API-spec PUT result. Consumers require HTTP 200, the expected deployment-v1 profile/target, durable=committed, live=applied and recovery_cleanup_authorized=true before automatic journal removal or dependent cleanup. Missing fields, refusal, cancellation and uncertain transport never authorize replay. Local application does not attest every remote DP.
